sky arts.desc: Filmed in front of a live studio audience at Sony Studios in New York City, Rod Stewart performs songs from his recent release "It Had to be You: The Great American Songbook".

sky arts.title: Portrait Artist Of The Year 2026
sky arts.desc: Nine artists paint food critic Grace Dent or comedians Munya Chawawa and Grace Campbell. Who will claim the final semi-final place? (S13, ep 8)

sky arts.title: Dusty Springfield Live At The Royal Albert Hall
sky arts.desc: British soul singer Dusty Springfield performs hits including We Are Family, All I See Is You and Son of a Preacher Man at a sold-out Royal Albert Hall in 1979.

sky arts.title: New: Tina Turner: Live at Gelre Dome, Holland 2009
sky arts.desc: New. Tina Turner returns to the stage to deliver an electric performance live from Gelredome in Arnhem, Holland, as part of the 50th Anniversary Tour.

sky arts.title: Beach Boys: Good Vibrations Tour
sky arts.desc: This biographical musical film directed by Gary Weis intertwines 1976 concert footage with interviews with the band, along with Blues Brothers Dan Aykroyd and John Belushi.

sky cinema premiere.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
sky cinema premiere.desc: Mario, Luigi and Princess Peach embark on an adventure across the galaxy.

sky cinema premiere.title: California Schemin'
sky cinema premiere.desc: Two Scottish lads from Dundee conned the music industry by pretending to be an established Californian rap duo, bagging a record deal and appearing on MTV until their scam unravelled.

sky cinema premiere.title: Mistletoe and Mimosas
sky cinema premiere.desc: After Claire inherits her uncle's Christmas-themed bar, she must square off against a neighbouring competitor to save it from its drowning debt.

sky cinema action.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
sky cinema action.desc: Sequel in which the entrepreneur who genetically engineered the dinosaurs in Jurassic Park transpires to have cloned more of the prehistoric monsters on another island location. Researchers arrive to observe the creatures in their natural habitat, but hot on their heels is a band of mercenaries intent on capturing the dinosaurs and transporting them back to San Diego Zoo.

sky cinema action.title: XXX 2: The Next Level
sky cinema action.desc: NSA Agent Augustus Gibbons, fresh off the success of his last renegade recruitment, once again finds himself in need of an outsider. Gibbons and his new agent must track a dangerous military splinter group that is conspiring to overthrow the US Government in the nation's capital.

sky cinema action.title: Green Lantern
sky cinema action.desc: A test pilot is granted a mystical green ring that bestows him with otherworldly powers, as well as membership into an intergalactic squadron tasked with keeping peace within the universe. Based on DC Comics characters.

sky cinema action.title: Jurassic World
sky cinema action.desc: Jurassic Park is now called Jurassic World, a fully functional dinosaur park that sees 20,000 visitors a year, the realisation of owner John Hammond's dreams. The scientists may have gone too far in creating some sort of hybrid dinosaur, which escapes and terrorises the park.

sky cinema family.title: Cats & Dogs
sky cinema family.desc: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

sky cinema family.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
sky cinema family.desc: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of Kitty Galore who dreams of global domination.

sky cinema family.title: Dog Man
sky cinema family.desc: A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

sky cinema comedy.title: Grimsby
sky cinema comedy.desc: Wrongfully accused and on the run, a top MI6 agent joins forces with his dimwitted brother to save the world from a sinister plot.

sky cinema comedy.title: The 'Burbs
sky cinema comedy.desc: An overstressed husband becomes obsessed with finding out the secret of his mysterious new neighbours. Concocting a series of increasingly outlandish schemes to discover the truth about the weird sounds he hears coming from the basement next door, the man settles on the theory that the family are a front for a cannibalistic cult.

sky cinema comedy.title: Coming 2 America
sky cinema comedy.desc: Needing a male heir to the throne, Prince Akeem returns to Queens, N.Y., to find his long-lost son and bring him back to Zamunda.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Pet Sematary
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Dr. Louis Creed and his wife, Rachel, relocate from Boston to rural Maine with their two young children. The couple soon discover a mysterious burial ground hidden deep in the woods near their new home. When tragedy strikes, Louis turns to his neighbour Jud Crandall, setting off a perilous chain reaction that unleashes an unspeakable evil with horrific consequences.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Lost Boys
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Fang-in-cheek tale about a single-parent family who move to the coastal town of Santa Clara where the local juvenile delinquents are actually a pack of vampires.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Perfect Storm
sky cinema thriller.desc: Seafaring drama based on the true story of a commercial fishing boat crew who become caught in a terrifying storm off the coast of Massachusetts. In the autumn of 1991, a fishing boat captain is determined to set sail despite the adverse weather conditions, but when the ice machine breaks down his decision to brave the storm rather than lose his catch results in a battle against 100ft waves.

sky cinema thriller.title: Clear and Present Danger
sky cinema thriller.desc: Investigating the assassination of a friend of the President, CIA agent Ryan discovers that his friend was in league with the Colombian drugs cartels. In revenge, a paramilitary force is sent in to wipe out the drug lords but when the operation goes wrong, they're abandoned by their country. Now their only hope is Ryan and fellow renegade operative Clark.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Untouchables
sky cinema thriller.desc: Lavish thriller about an idealistic federal agent who vows to bring down Al Capone and his underworld crime syndicate in Prohibition-era Chicago. With police corruption rife, he forms a special team for the task and relies on a veteran street cop - passed over for promotion because he is honest - to clean up the force and trap Capone.

sky cinema thriller.title: How to Make a Killing
sky cinema thriller.desc: Disowned at birth by his wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

sky cinema greats.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
sky cinema greats.desc: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.

sky cinema greats.title: Sixteen Candles
sky cinema greats.desc: A teen suffers the pain of adolescence as she longs for Mr. Right while fending off the advances of the class clown.

sky cinema greats.title: Tootsie
sky cinema greats.desc: An out-of-work actor dresses in drag for an audition, only to land the female lead in a TV soap. When he becomes the most popular character on the show, he feels compelled to carry the persona into his everyday life. While bringing him phenomenal success as an `actress', life as a woman also has its problems - especially when he falls for an actress with whom he works.

sky cinema greats.title: The Wedding Singer
sky cinema greats.desc: When one-time rock hopeful Robbie is jilted at the altar, he vents his bitterness in song, even when singing at other people's weddings. Only true love can redeem the broken hearted songster but fortunately, he's about to meet a woman who will spin him right round (like a record).

sky cinema drama.title: Dreamgirls
sky cinema drama.desc: Following the adventures of The Dreamettes, an all-girl singing group. They're going nowhere fast until they meet fast-talking car salesman-come-manager who has ambitions to make a fortune selling black music to a white audience. He persuades them to become backing singers for James `Thunder' Early, but the larger-than-life lead singer Effie White must step out of the spotlight in favour of the more image-friendly Deena Jones.

sky cinema drama.title: True Grit
sky cinema drama.desc: John Wayne won an Oscar here as Rooster Cogburn, a lawman recruited by a teenager seeking revenge on her father's murderer.

sky cinema drama.title: Quartet
sky cinema drama.desc: A long-smouldering flame is rekindled when a once-popular opera star reunites with her ex-husband and fellow performers at a retirement home for musicians.
